findings.description: Impartial listening becomes open listening.

contexts.WH: "Because I am no one, I can listen to your tale openly and record it.  You will probably leave this world before too long.  If you die without telling anything about Beatrice, your children will adorn Beatrice with whatever tale they like, and write that into their memories."

contexts.UP: I can listen to your tale without bias and record it.
